reason: This plugin is primarily a media/assistant-chat UI utility: it turns Markdown image references in assistant messages into an in-page gallery in the DSH web interface, with optional captions and click-open behavior. Evidence shows limited local file serving logic (workspace path validation, size cap, content-type handling), which introduces non-trivial file-access behavior, so classification is cautious at low-to-moderate risk while still approving the submission.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DSH Web 聊天界面中将 Markdown 图片引用渲染为助手消息下方的图片画廊，并支持本地路径、数据 URI 与标题显示。
summaries.en: This plugin renders Markdown image references into a gallery under assistant messages in the DSH web chat UI, including local-path and data URI handling with optional captions.

capabilities: Renders Markdown image references in assistant replies as an on-page gallery.
Serves and validates local workspace image paths through a host route before rendering.
Handles image fallbacks and basic click-to-open behavior for local resources.

reasons.code: Repository description and README state the plugin renders chat Markdown image references as a gallery under assistant messages in the DSH web GUI.
README documents validated local workspace file handling with size/path checks and failure fallbacks; HTTP(S) image refs are skipped and data URLs render directly.
Package metadata includes DSH web client/bundle manifest fields indicating it is a DSH web plugin that runs in the GUI extension context.
Repository is public and active, with required entry files present, indicating normal plugin distribution and runtime setup.
